SELECT
    R.REGISTRATION_ID,
    R.TERMINAL_ID,
    T.TERMINAL_KIND,
    R.SYSTEM_CODE,
    R.MID,
    R.TID,
    R.UPG_CATEGORY,
    R.GENERATED_AT,
    R.CREATED_AT,
    R.UPDATED_AT
FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL_SYSTEM_REGISTRATION R
JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_TERMINAL T
  ON T.TERMINAL_ID = R.TERMINAL_ID
 AND T.IS_DELETED = 0
JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT M
  ON M.MERCHANT_ID = T.MERCHANT_ID
 AND M.IS_DELETED = 0
WHERE M.MERCHANT_ID = HEXTORAW('{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.MERCHANT_ID || "59F2A096E5047D26E063C642320AB95B" }}')
  AND R.SYSTEM_CODE = 'UPG'
  AND R.IS_DELETED = 0
ORDER BY T.TERMINAL_ID
